# INHERIT Conformance Declaration

Machine-readable declaration of an implementation's conformance to the INHERIT standard. Governance requires two independent Level 2 implementations to promote schemas from draft to stable

Source: [`v3/conformance-declaration.json`](../../v3/conformance-declaration.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/conformance-declaration.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `implementation` | `string` | yes | Name of the implementation (product, service, or library) |
| `implementationVersion` | `string` | yes | Version of the implementation being declared |
| `inheritVersion` | `string` | yes | INHERIT schema version this declaration applies to |
| `conformanceLevel` | one of `1`, `2`, `3` | yes | Overall conformance level achieved. The minimum across all declared entities |
| `declaredAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | ISO 8601 timestamp when this declaration was generated |
| `validatorDetails` | `object` | | Details of the validator used to verify conformance |
| `entities` | `object` | yes | Per-entity conformance results. Keys are entity schema names (e.g. 'estate', 'person', 'bequest') |
| `extensions` | `object` | | Per-extension conformance results. Keys are extension identifiers (e.g. 'uk-england-wales', 'islamic-succession') |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this conformance declaration |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `disclaimer` | const `Validation results are informational. They verify schema conformance and data structure, not legal accuracy or completeness. Do not rely on validation results as the sole basis for legal or financial decisions.` | | Legal disclaimer on validation results. Validation checks JSON Schema conformance and referential integrity. It does not verify legal accuracy, completeness, or suitability for any jurisdiction's requirements |

## Definitions

<a id="def-EntityConformance"></a>

### EntityConformance

Conformance result for a single entity schema

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | one of `1`, `2`, `3` | yes | Conformance level tested |
| `passed` | `boolean` | yes | Whether the entity passed at the declared level |
| `errors` | `integer` | | Number of validation errors (0 if passed) |
| `warnings` | `integer` | | Number of validation warnings |
| `skipped` | `boolean` | | Whether this entity was skipped (not applicable to this implementation) |
| `notes` | `string` | | Per-entity notes |

<a id="def-ExtensionConformance"></a>

### ExtensionConformance

Conformance result for a single extension

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | one of `1`, `2`, `3` | yes | Conformance level tested |
| `passed` | `boolean` | yes | Whether the extension passed at the declared level |
| `errors` | `integer` | | Number of validation errors |
| `warnings` | `integer` | | Number of validation warnings |
| `jurisdictionsVerified` | array of `string` | | Which jurisdictions were verified for Level 3 |
| `notes` | `string` | | Per-extension notes |
